project_info.theme: Earth Day lifestyle beauty snapshot with eco-friendly gifting and green sprout symbolism
project_info.color_palette: Sky Blue, Grass Green, Cocoa Brown, Kraft Beige, Soft Pink, Sunlit Cream

main_subject.detail: A candid mirror selfie composition centered on Cocoon Dak Lak coffee body polish in a dark brown jar with fresh green sprouts growing out of the open top, held forward by a smiling person reflected in a round mirror, with a small amber vial labeled 'Hạt giống Mầm Xanh Hạnh Phúc' placed in the foreground.
main_subject.style: Natural lifestyle product photography, scrapbook sticker accents, cheerful eco-campaign aesthetic, realistic handheld snapshot with playful youthful styling

composition_elements.text: Visible packaging text includes 'MẦM XANH HẠNH PHÚC', Cocoon product label text, and the vial label 'Hạt giống Mầm Xanh Hạnh Phúc'.
items: Top Left: Round mirror frame cutting into the scene, with a smiling person in beige shirt reflected and holding the coffee body polish toward the mirror.
Top Right: Second person partially visible in mirror taking the photo with a silver smartphone, plus an angled product box showing partial green vertical text on the outer edge.
Bottom Left: Soft-focus green leaves, a large flat illustrated brown shovel sticker, and product box packaging with recycling icon leaning into the mirror scene.
Bottom Right: Large white box with bold green text 'MẦM XANH HẠNH PHÚC', pink flower sticker with yellow sparkle center, and the small amber vial in the foreground.
Center/Background: Green textured fabric under all props, outdoor blue-sky reflection inside the mirror, grassy field horizon, and extra Cocoon bottles near the lower edge.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Direct sunny highlights, crisp outdoor reflections, soft real shadows from props, warm spring picnic mood, lightly glossy mirror glare

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity lifestyle product photography, smartphone social creative, realistic editorial flat-lay plus reflection composition

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for an Earth Day lifestyle beauty snapshot with eco-friendly gifting and green sprout symbolism. Centerpiece is a Cocoon Dak Lak coffee body polish jar with fresh green sprouts emerging from the top, presented toward a round mirror by a smiling person while a second person photographs the scene with a silver smartphone. Background is green textured picnic fabric surrounding a circular mirror reflection of blue sky and grassy field. Surrounding elements: kraft product boxes with recycling graphics, a large white box reading 'MẦM XANH HẠNH PHÚC', small amber vials labeled 'Hạt giống Mầm Xanh Hạnh Phúc', blurred foreground leaves, a flat brown shovel sticker, and a pink flower sticker. Keep the candid mirror-selfie angle, direct sunlight, realistic hand placement, exact Vietnamese wording, and youthful scrapbook styling. Technical style: high fidelity lifestyle product photography, smartphone social creative, bright natural sunlight, direct sunny highlights and crisp outdoor reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
